title: Binary search
summary: Halve a search space with a monotone condition: sorted arrays, boundaries, and searching on the answer.

questions.prompt: With inclusive bounds (lo and hi are both possible answers), complete the loop condition.

options: Remember mid as a candidate and keep searching to the left (hi = mid - 1)

options: Binary search on the capacity, checking each candidate with a greedy pass
Try every capacity from the largest package up to the total weight
